messages:
Aisha Khan: Heads-up: AMD just flagged a regression in the MI300 driver stack that could push APAC validation out. need to align marketplace timeline + SI dry-runs. thoughts?
Tom Becker: can you paste the regression details? is it a perf regression or stability?
amd_suzanne: quick summary: driver 5.3.2 has a memory-mapping regression under high-concurrency NVF queueing. causes occasional OOM in our perf harness, more visible at batch sizes >16. fix targeted in 5.3.3 but ETA is ~10 days.
Luc Moreau: OOMs will kill our KV cache experiments. if APAC lab still green we could do NA/EU first and gate APAC until 5.3.3. but need to check contractual SLA language for region availability.
Jenny Park: product/marketing note: if we stagger regions we need clear UI flags: "beta - limited capacity" + a short tooltip explaining expected behaviors. also support playbook for customers who hit OOMs.
Aisha Khan: okay proposal: 1) hold global press, 2) list MI300 in marketplace for NA/EU with "preview" state on 2026-06-20, 3) push APAC listing to 2026-07-05 post-driver 5.3.3 validation. 4) schedule SI integrator dry-run for 2026-06-14 (NA/EU) and 06-28 (APAC).
Tom Becker: SI team can do a focused run 06-14. need container tags and test matrix. Luc, can infra spin a <small>ci/mi300-preview</small> image?
Luc Moreau: yes. I'll tag `redwood/mi300:preview-20260610` and open a short-readme. test commands: ```bash
# smoke
docker run --rm --gpus=all redwood/mi300:preview-20260610 python -m redwood.smoketest --concurrency 32 --batch-size 16
```
Jenny Park: communications: i'll draft marketplace text. Proposed copy snippet: "MI300 preview available in NA & EU. APAC availability to follow after driver validation. Customers with latency-sensitive workloads should evaluate H100/H200 fallbacks."
Aisha Khan: fallback routing needs policy. Ops: default fallback -> H200, then H100. Also need billing note when fallback happens (token discount? or pro-rate?).
cloud-partner-bot: Reminder: contractual region availability check required for offering changes. Please attach legal sign-off before public listing.
Tom Becker: billing: recommend not to auto-discount. instead surface a banner and provide credit for verified incidents. finance signoff needed.
amd_suzanne: vendor will push 5.3.3 to partners on 2026-06-22. validation window ~3 business days in partner labs. we'll send an embargoed test plan by 06-18.
Aisha Khan: timeline recap in-thread: SI dry-run (NA/EU) 2026-06-14, vendor 5.3.3 ship 2026-06-22, APAC dry-run 06-28, APAC listing 07-05, global press/joint announcement TBD after APAC validation (aim for 07-08+). action owners: Luc -> container + readme, Tom -> SI test matrix + billing proposal, Jenny -> listing copy + support Q&A, Aisha -> legal & press cadence.
Luc Moreau: will upload image + minimal test harness by 2026-06-10 EOD.
Jenny Park: will share marketplace draft by 2026-06-11.
Tom Becker: SI matrix highlights: p95/p99 tails, memory footprint under multi-tenant, KV cache warmup times, autoscale triggers. I'll circulate on Monday.
Aisha Khan: thanks. @amd_suzanne pls add the embargoed validation results when ready. also adding a calendar check: brief sync 2026-06-23 to review partner lab results. :calendar:
release-bot: Pipeline queued: `marketplace-preview` for NA/EU listing on 2026-06-20 16:00 UTC, pending legal sign-off.
